name: search_memory
description: Full-text search with BM25 ranking (industry-standard relevance scoring). Faster and smarter than simple keyword matching. Features: stemming ('running' matches 'run'), phrase search ('"Flask API"'), boolean operators ('flask OR express'). Use for 1-3 word searches. For natural language questions (4+ words), use semantic_recall instead.

query.description: Search term to find in stored memories
